text: Figure 5.6: Sequence diagram of NvM access for use case 1b • Applicability: In this use case, NvM users (SW-C) can control their data in a more efficient way as they are responsible for copying consistent data to and from the NvM module’s RAM mirror. It is possible to modify application data just before writing into RAM mirror. The drawback is need of an additional RAM in NvM module that needs to have the same size as the NVRAM block and the necessity of an additional copy for read / write operation.
